Container.Name: Ghost-Hub
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted digital-footprint cleaner. Connect Gmail, Outlook / Microsoft 365 (through OAuth apps you create) and Yahoo, AOL, iCloud or any IMAP mailbox (app password). Ghost-Hub reads message headers only, never bodies, to find the services you have signed up for, scores each one for risk using Have I Been Pwned's public breach list, shows how to delete the accounts you do not need, helps you unsubscribe from newsletters after you review exactly what will be sent, and finds public profiles under your own usernames. Nothing happens without your approval, and your data stays on your server.
Requires a PostgreSQL container (set its address in Database URL). Every mail provider is optional: Gmail and Outlook need an OAuth app you create once (see the project docs), Yahoo and IMAP need only an app password. Google and Microsoft only allow sign-in over HTTPS (or localhost), so put Ghost-Hub behind a reverse proxy and set App URL to its https address. Full guide: docs/UNRAID.md.
Pre-release: tested against fake mail servers, not yet against many real accounts.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: privacy digital footprint gmail outlook yahoo imap accounts breach haveibeenpwned unsubscribe newsletters delete account cleanup
Container.Requires: Requires a PostgreSQL container (any current version). Set Database URL to point at it.
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0 First pre-release. - Connect Gmail, Outlook / Microsoft 365 and Yahoo / AOL / iCloud / IMAP mailboxes (read-only). - Header-only inbox scan that finds the services you have signed up for. - Dashboard with a 0-100 risk score per service and breach matching (Have I Been Pwned). - Review-first bulk newsletter unsubscribe (one-click senders). - Step-by-step account deletion guides, and a flag if a company keeps emailing after you delete. - Public profile finder for your own usernames and Gravatar-linked accounts.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: The address you open Ghost-Hub at, for example https://hub.example.com. Used for the Gmail and Outlook sign-in redirect and the session cookie. Gmail and Outlook only work with an https address (or localhost): see docs/UNRAID.md.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the web login. Use 12 or more characters; common placeholder values are refused.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32-byte base64 key that encrypts the logins Ghost-Hub stores. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32. Back it up: if you lose it you must reconnect every mailbox.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string for your Postgres container, for example postgres://ghosthub:YOUR_PASSWORD@UNRAID_IP:5432/ghosthub.

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, for Gmail. From your own Google Cloud OAuth client (see docs/SETUP-GOOGLE-OAUTH.md in the project). You can leave this empty and enter it later on Ghost-Hub's Settings page.

Config.Name: Google Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional, for Gmail. Secret for your Google OAuth client. You can leave this empty and enter it later on Ghost-Hub's Settings page.

Config.Name: Microsoft Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, for Outlook / Microsoft 365. Application (client) ID of your own Entra app registration (see docs/SETUP-MICROSOFT-OAUTH.md in the project). You can leave this empty and enter it later on Ghost-Hub's Settings page.

Config.Name: Microsoft Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional, for Outlook / Microsoft 365. Client secret value of your Entra app registration. You can leave this empty and enter it later on Ghost-Hub's Settings page.

Config.Name: Microsoft Tenant
Config.Description: common = personal and work/school accounts. Use consumers for personal accounts only, or a tenant ID. You can leave this empty and enter it later on Ghost-Hub's Settings page.

Config.Name: Breach Lookups
Config.Description: true downloads Have I Been Pwned's public breach list to score your services (nothing about you is sent). Set to false to make no Have I Been Pwned calls at all.

Config.Name: HIBP API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Your own Have I Been Pwned API key. Lets you press Check on the dashboard to see whether your email addresses appear in breaches (that sends the address to Have I Been Pwned). Without it, services are matched against the free public breach list by domain. You can leave this empty and enter it later on Ghost-Hub's Settings page.
